To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the vibro acoustic analysis of cellular materials requires a special approach.
a multiscale approach is a promising approach to improve the vibro acoustic simulations for cellular metals and that it can be used for the vibro acoustic optimization of cellular structures.
the vibro acoustic properties of aluminium foam components can be predicted with good accuracy by using a multiscale approach.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the simulation of vibro acoustic characteristics (natural frequencies and mode shapes) for complex cellular materials using multi scale techniques.
a vibro acoustic simulation technique that can be used for the analysis of cellular materials.
the development of a simulation technique that is capable of predicting the vibro acoustic behaviour of cellular metals.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the multiscale approach is a good compromise between precision and time efficiency.
the vibro acoustic analysis of complex cellular metals is feasible with the proposed approach and can be used as a design tool in the early design stage.
the vibro acoustic behaviour of cellular metals can be modelled precisely with the multiscale approach using representative volume elements.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the vibro acoustic behaviour of cellular metal parts can be modelled with sufficient accuracy by using a multiscale approach with representative volume elements.
the vibro acoustic simulations of cellular metals can be performed in a very efficient way using the presented approach.
the simulation of the vibro acoustic behaviour of cellular metals can be performed with high accuracy and efficiency by using the multiscale approach.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the simulation results can be improved significantly with a more detailed description of the material microstructure.
with the proposed approach the vibro acoustic analysis of complex structures made of aluminium foams is possible with acceptable efficiency.
a detailed microstructure simulation model can be created with reasonable effort and that this model is sufficiently precise for vibro acoustic simulations of cellular metal parts.
